note: Trempealeau County park on the Trempealeau River between Arcadia and Independence on WI-93, with river access, a swimming beach and canoe landing by the lower loop, trails and disc golf. The water/electric sites are shaded; the electric-only sites are open. Group sites and a horse site are sold separately. An overflow field fills for large summer weekend events. --Claude
